correctness.rationale: Under exact line search the source correction term vanishes and RMIL/MRMIL coincide. Exact orthogonality identities give the first A-conjugate pair, then force the displayed third-direction defect. Its sign is strictly negative because \(\lVert d_1\rVert^2=\lVert g_1\rVert^2+\beta_1^2\lVert d_0\rVert^2>\lVert g_1\rVert^2\). Dimension minimality follows analytically for dimensions one and two and by an exact-rational three-dimensional witness. The packaged checker returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Quadratic A-conjugacy and dimension-step finite termination are structural benchmark properties of conjugate-gradient methods, not arbitrary diagnostics. The source explicitly compares its setting with classical exact-line quadratic CG and calls the constructions conjugate-gradient methods. Identifying the first unavoidable conjugacy break, proving the exact defect, and locating the minimum dimension where finite termination actually fails materially clarifies what the sufficient-descent modification preserves and what it does not.
